title: Little Office of S. John of God, Whose Fiery Birth was Revealed by Divine Intervention

introductoryNotes.text: From a book of the same name published in 1692

translationNotice: English translation prepared for Sacrum Florilegium; not supplied in the source PDF.

blocks.source: ℣. Domine labia mea aperies.
blocks.english: ℣. O Lord, Thou shalt open my lips.

blocks.source: ℟. Et os meum annuntiabit laudem tuam.
blocks.english: ℟. And my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

blocks.source: ℣. Deus in adjutorium meum intende.
blocks.english: ℣. O God, come to my assistance.

blocks.source: ℟. Domine ad adjuvandum me festina.
blocks.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

blocks.source: ℣. Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto.
blocks.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

blocks.source: ℟. Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper, et in saecula saeculorum. Amen. Alleluia.
blocks.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Alleluia.

blocks.source: Hymnus
blocks.english: Hymn

blocks.source: Laus Joanni sit, qui Patrum Posuit primordia, Sacri Ordinis, et Fratrum de misericordia,
blocks.english: Praise be to John, who laid the beginnings of the Fathers, of the sacred Order and the Brothers of Mercy,

blocks.source: Cujus ortu glorioso Gaudet Lusitania Fato sit hic ominoso Miles in Hispania,
blocks.english: In whose glorious birth Portugal rejoices. Under an ominous fate he becomes a soldier in Spain,

blocks.source: Apparente sed mutavit Divae Deiparae, Et ad pia applicavit Charitatis opera.
blocks.english: But, when the holy Mother of God appeared, he changed and applied himself to the loving works of charity.
blocks.editorialNote: The PDF prints the incomplete construction “Apparente sed mutavit / Divae Deiparae.” The prepared English provisionally understands a change following the apparition of the Mother of God; the printed Latin is retained.

blocks.source: Antiphona
blocks.english: Antiphon

blocks.source: Fidelis servus, et prudens quem constituit Dominus super familiam suam pro cura infirmorum, pauperum, et afflictorum.
blocks.english: The faithful and prudent servant whom the Lord placed over His household to care for the sick, the poor, and the afflicted.

blocks.source: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancte Joannes Dei.
blocks.english: ℣. Pray for us, Saint John of God.

blocks.source: ℟. Ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi.
blocks.english: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

blocks.source: Oremus,
blocks.english: Let us pray,

blocks.source: Deus, qui per caritatem beati Joannis Dei infirmis, pauperibus, et afflictis clementer subvenisti: concede propitius, ut ejus meritis et precibus ab omni semper infirmitate, periculo, et adversitate misericorditer protegamur et liberemur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, etc.
blocks.english: O God, Who through the charity of blessed John of God didst graciously succour the sick, the poor, and the afflicted: mercifully grant that by his merits and prayers we may always be protected and delivered from every infirmity, danger, and adversity. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, etc.

blocks.source: ℣. Deus in adjutorium meum intende.
blocks.english: ℣. O God, come to my assistance.

blocks.source: ℟. Domine ad adjuvandum me festina. Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto, Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper, et in saecula saeculorum. Amen. Alleluia.
blocks.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Alleluia.

blocks.source: Hymnus
blocks.english: Hymn

blocks.source: Ut vitaret mundi viam, Lubrica carnalia, Ad agendam vitam piam Fundat hospitalia.
blocks.english: To avoid the world’s path and the slippery snares of the flesh, he founds hospitals to lead a devout life.

blocks.source: Et infirmos derelictos Excipit hospitio, Consolatur et afflictos, Pauperes servitio.
blocks.english: He receives the abandoned sick with hospitality, consoles the afflicted, and serves the poor.

blocks.source: Antiphona
blocks.english: Antiphon

blocks.source: Felix sanctus Joannes, cui Dominus ad exemplum Moysis erga proximos caritatem et fraternae salutis zelum inspiravit.
blocks.english: Happy Saint John, into whom the Lord, after the example of Moses, breathed charity towards his neighbours and zeal for his brethren’s salvation.

blocks.source: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancte Joannes Dei.
blocks.english: ℣. Pray for us, Saint John of God.

blocks.source: ℟. Ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi.
blocks.english: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

blocks.source: Oratio.
blocks.english: Prayer.

blocks.source: Hymnus
blocks.english: Hymn

blocks.source: Aegros curat, fovet, sanat, Et dementes recipit, Moribundis viam planat Et defunctos sepelit.
blocks.english: He cares for, cherishes, and heals the sick, and receives those with disordered minds. He smooths the way for the dying and buries the dead.

blocks.source: Spiritualem corporalem Caritatem habuit, Esse semper hospitalem Omnibus exhibuit.
blocks.english: He possessed spiritual and bodily charity, and showed himself always hospitable to all.

blocks.source: Antiphona
blocks.english: Antiphon

blocks.source: Beatus sanctus Joannes, quem Deus ad exemplum Tobiae insigni patientia et erga proximos misericordia decoravit.
blocks.english: Blessed Saint John, whom God, after the example of Tobias, adorned with outstanding patience and mercy towards his neighbours.

blocks.source: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancte Joannes Dei.
blocks.english: ℣. Pray for us, Saint John of God.

blocks.english: Hymn

blocks.source: Verus hinc Samaritanus, Et fundator Ordinis, Pius fuit Lusitanus, Clarus et miraculis.
blocks.english: Thus this devout Portuguese was a true Samaritan and founder of an Order, renowned also for miracles.

blocks.source: Vitam duxit rigorosam Flagris et jejunio, Vigilando gloriosam Luctam cum diabolo.
blocks.english: He led a rigorous life with scourges and fasting, keeping watch in a glorious struggle with the devil.

blocks.source: Antiphona
blocks.english: Antiphon

blocks.source: Beatus sanctus Joannes, qui intellexit super egenum, pauperem et infirmum, et propter misericordiam Regnum Dei consecutus est.
blocks.english: Blessed Saint John, who considered the needy, the poor, and the sick, and because of mercy attained the Kingdom of God.

blocks.source: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancte Joannes Dei.
blocks.english: ℣. Pray for us, Saint John of God.

blocks.source: ℟. Ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi.

blocks.source: Hymnus
blocks.english: Hymn

blocks.source: Sitam animam afflictam Dedit patientiae, Nullam voluit vindictam
blocks.english: He gave his afflicted soul to patience; he desired no vengeance,
blocks.editorialNote: The PDF prints “Sitam animam afflictam,” where the context suggests “Suam.” The prepared English provisionally renders “his afflicted soul”; the printed Latin is retained.

blocks.source: Patiens injuriae. Hunc Maria coronavit Spinis in Ecclesia.
blocks.english: Patient under injury. Mary crowned him with thorns in the church.

blocks.source: Antiphona
blocks.english: Antiphon

blocks.source: Beatus ille discipulus, qui dilexit proximum et legem implevit; beatus qui cum Samaritano misericordiam fecit proximo.
blocks.english: Blessed is that disciple who loved his neighbour and fulfilled the law; blessed is he who, with the Samaritan, showed mercy to his neighbour.

blocks.source: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancte Joannes Dei.
blocks.english: ℣. Pray for us, Saint John of God.

blocks.source: ℟. Ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi.
blocks.english: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

blocks.english: Prayer.

blocks.source: Hymnus
blocks.english: Hymn

blocks.source: Jesum cum ignotum foris Ut aegrotum suscipit, Proximum ab hoc amoris Nomen Dei recipit.
blocks.english: When he receives Jesus, unknown, outside his doors as a sick man, from this love of neighbour he receives the name “of God.”

blocks.source: Ab Octavo est relatus Alexandro civibus, Coeli atque declaratus Sanctus Dei famulus.
blocks.english: By Alexander the Eighth he was numbered among the citizens of heaven and declared a holy servant of God.

blocks.source: Antiphona
blocks.english: Antiphon

blocks.source: Beatus servus quem Dominus in caritate et misericordia vigilantem invenit, et ideo super multa constituit.
blocks.english: Blessed is the servant whom the Lord found watchful in charity and mercy, and therefore set over many things.

blocks.source: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancte Joannes Dei.
blocks.english: ℣. Pray for us, Saint John of God.

blocks.source: ℟. Ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi.
blocks.english: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

blocks.source: Oratio.
blocks.english: Prayer.

blocks.source: ℣. Converte nos, Deus salutaris noster.
blocks.english: ℣. Convert us, O God our Saviour.

blocks.source: ℟. Et averte iram tuam a nobis.
blocks.english: ℟. And turn away Thine anger from us.

blocks.source: ℣. Deus in adjutorium meum intende.
blocks.english: ℣. O God, come to my assistance.

blocks.source: ℟. Domine ad adjuvandum me festina. Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto, Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper, et in saecula saeculorum. Amen. Alleluia.
blocks.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Alleluia.

blocks.source: Hymnus
blocks.english: Hymn

blocks.source: O Joannes, pro me ora, Et a Deo impetra, Faciam ut omni hora Caritatis opera.
blocks.english: O John, pray for me and obtain from God that at every hour I may perform works of charity,

blocks.source: Ut ex orbis hospitali Tecum ire merear, Et in vita aeterna Tua sorte perfruar.
blocks.english: That I may be found worthy to depart with thee from the hospital of this world, and in eternal life enjoy thy blessed lot.

blocks.source: Antiphona
blocks.english: Antiphon

blocks.source: Mirabilis Deus in sancto Joanne, quem propter caritatem et misericordiam continua miraculorum gloria et honore coronat.
blocks.english: Wonderful is God in Saint John, whom, because of charity and mercy, He crowns with continual glory and honour through miracles.

blocks.source: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancte Joannes Dei.
blocks.english: ℣. Pray for us, Saint John of God.

blocks.source: ℟. Ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi.
blocks.english: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

blocks.source: Oratio.
blocks.english: Prayer.

Through our Lord Jesus Christ, etc.

blocks.source: Sancte Pater, hoc oblatum Suscipe officium. Fac ut Deo fiat gratum Meum hoc servitium.
blocks.english: Holy Father, receive this office offered to thee. Make this service of mine pleasing to God.

blocks.source: Cura, sana, me tuere, Omni purga vitio. Tibi me fac congaudere Coeli in hospitio.
blocks.english: Care for me, heal me, protect me, cleanse me from every vice. Grant that I may rejoice with thee in heaven’s hospitable dwelling.

blocks.source: Antiphona
blocks.english: Antiphon

blocks.source: O zelator fidei et amator pacis, lumen virtutum et speculum caritatis, Pater pauperum et spiritus humilitatis, qui incepisti ordinem super hospitalitatem: intercede pro nobis apud sanctam et individuam Trinitatem.
blocks.english: O zealous guardian of faith and lover of peace, light of virtues and mirror of charity, father of the poor and spirit of humility, who didst begin an Order devoted to hospitality, intercede for us with the holy and undivided Trinity.

blocks.source: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancte Joannes Dei.
blocks.english: ℣. Pray for us, Saint John of God.

blocks.source: ℟. Ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi.
blocks.english: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

blocks.source: Oremus, Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, Pater pauperum, humilium celsitudo et caritatis amator: te humiliter deprecamur, ut sicut Ecclesia tua beati Joannis Dei paupertate, humilitate et caritate coruscata, ita et nos ejus meritis et exemplis eadem sectantes, cum ipso in aeterna gloria feliciter coronari mereamur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus, per omnia saecula saeculorum.
blocks.english: Let us pray. Almighty and everlasting God, Father of the poor, exaltation of the humble, and lover of charity, we humbly beseech Thee that, as Thy Church shines with the poverty, humility, and charity of Blessed John of God, so we also, following these virtues through his merits and examples, may be found worthy to be happily crowned with him in eternal glory. Through Jesus Christ, Thy Son, our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, for ever and ever.
blocks.editorialNote: The PDF omits a finite verb in “sicut Ecclesia tua ... coruscata.” The prepared English provisionally supplies “shines” to express the evident comparison; the Latin is retained.

blocks.source: ℟. Amen.
blocks.english: ℟. Amen.

editorialNotes.text: English prepared after visual comparison with PDF pages 541–544. All seven printed hours and the Commendation are retained. The source prints each hour’s collect in full; no Lauds is added. Incomplete or irregular printed constructions are marked inline for source resolution.
